title: Partial Salesforce success - completed and incomplete parts recorded honestly; exception decision requested
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `partial-salesforce-success` (partial success recorded honestly; exception decision requested). Specified against the in-memory fake ExecutionTarget/StatusSource per the captain's standing Salesforce directive; the REAL managed-package behavior re-proves this case when the sandbox trigger fires.

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Draft models the partial split as instruction-created (completed) vs disbursement-scheduled (incomplete); the captain confirms the part taxonomy once managed-package archaeology (prompt 27) reveals the real seams. Case expectations hold against fakes NOW; realness is deferred-pending-sandbox. Captain reapproved the explicit evidence-completeness matrix and canonical UTC timestamps on 2026-07-28.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the $75,000 request; after approval and revalidation the external capability accepts the instruction record but fails to schedule the disbursement leg.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD; external capability reports partial acceptance (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Available taxable liquidity is 420000 USD and the reserve is satisfied; evaluation is clean - the partial outcome is an execution-plane event.
Planned withdrawals are 8000 USD per month; the six-month reserve is 48000 USD and remains preserved after the movement.
No active pending or reserved liquidity activity was observed at evaluation time.
Destination bank instruction is household-titled, independently verified, and has no unresolved recent change.
The destination restriction permits this request's household-titled destination.

expectedAuthority.note: Standard Firm A dual approval above 25000 USD; the interesting behavior begins after execution starts.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: Approvals recorded and revalidation passed - execution legitimately started; the partial outcome is discovered from the external receipt, not predicted.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: The external receipt reports completed part 'instruction-created' and incomplete part 'disbursement-scheduled' - both lists are displayed verbatim with the exact source status; nothing is rounded up to success.

A partial movement is neither done nor safely retryable as a whole, so policy requires a derived exception decision (complete the remainder, compensate, or hold) instead of an automatic retry - the failure never disappears into logs (v3 invariant 24).

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Evaluation snapshots pinned into the bundle.
Proceed decision with dual-approval authority and execution plan.
Liquidity reservation created before execution; NOT released while parts remain incomplete.
Single external instruction started under the stable idempotency key.
Receipt records completedParts=[instruction-created], incompleteParts=[disbursement-scheduled], with the exact sourceStatus string.
Polled status maps to Unknown - the source cannot yet prove the disbursement leg's state; the raw sourceStatus is preserved alongside.
The partial outcome derives a new decision request referencing the prior decision and the triggering ledger entry (reason: partial-execution).

expectedVerificationState.note: Verification cannot close: the completed part is proven, the incomplete part is not, and the surface says exactly that. All external responses here are fake-adapter-response until the sandbox trigger fires; this case is re-proven against the real managed package then (deferred-pending-sandbox).
